title: Silverfox Piercing Frame Solo #60 (국제 · 허리 컷 · P25 집중형 · 재질 이레즈미 · 체형 wide hip narrow · 금속 금)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, waist shot. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed from the very top of her head down to just below her navel, the frame cutting off across her lower belly. Her face sits in the upper part of the frame, large enough to read every piercing, and her ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Early 50s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult woman — THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s silver fox goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, silver-white sleek straight hair falling past her shoulders. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, a bold, commanding expression — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge yellow-gold bar hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide yellow-gold ear cuff, three smaller yellow-gold rings, two thick yellow-gold bars and a small yellow-gold stud up to the top; one small yellow-gold stud sits in the right ear; four yellow-gold pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small yellow-gold rings pass through the left nostril and a thick yellow-gold septum ring hangs below the nose; a yellow-gold hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a yellow-gold snake-bite ring beside it and a small yellow-gold ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a yellow-gold Medusa stud sits above the lips; a yellow-gold labret stud and a small yellow-gold ring sit on the chin; three small yellow-gold studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small rubies set into the metal. All jewelry is real yellow gold, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is fused with one material instead of ordinary skin: traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, lotus pond formations in VIVID PINK and DEEP EMERALD, extreme high-gloss oil finish, covering every inch from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame without exception, the material reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Real skin on the face, ears and neck ends cleanly at the base of the neck and across both collarbones, and everything below it is the body treatment described above.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
